description: List rides, optionally filtered by status and/or rider. Sorted by requested_at descending.

status.description: Optional ride status filter (requested, accepted, in_progress, completed, cancelled).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of ride summaries.

description: Retrieve the full ride object by rid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full ride including timestamps and rating.

description: Request a new ride. Ride is created with status 'requested' and no assigned driver.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new ride summary.

description: Driver accepts a requested ride. Marks driver as unavailable and ride as 'accepted'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated ride summary.

description: Driver begins the trip. Ride must be in 'accepted' status; moves to 'in_progress' with started_at set.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated ride summary.

description: Complete an in-progress ride with a final fare. Marks driver available again.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the completed ride summary.

description: Cancel a ride that has not yet completed. Frees the assigned driver if any.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the cancelled ride summary.

description: Rate a completed ride (1..5). Fails if the ride is not yet completed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the rated ride summary.

description: List drivers, optionally filtered by availability.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of driver objects.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the driver object.

is_available.description: Whether the driver is initially available.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new driver object.

description: List all riders known to this session.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of rider objects.
A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new rider object.

description: Append a saved place (label + address) to an existing rider.

place.description: Place description or address string to save.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated rider object.

description: Aggregate ride statistics: totals by status, completed fare sum, and average rating.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {total_rides, by_status, drivers, riders, total_completed_fare, avg_rating}.
